_README: 風險因素年度變化（報告頁「🔄 風險因素的年度變化」一節）的繁體中文譯文。
鍵是原文摘錄的 SHA-1 前 12 碼（scripts/risk_translations.py 的 key()）。
申報書改動一個字，鍵就不同，舊譯文會自動失效並回到「尚未翻譯」，
而不是安靜地掛在一段已經不一樣的原文上。
en 欄是被翻譯的那段原文摘錄，只為了讓人能對照檢查，程式不讀它。
頁面永遠同時附上完整原文，譯文不取代原文。
新申報書一定會帶進沒翻過的段落，那時頁面顯示原文並標示「尚未翻譯」。
缺譯文不是錯誤，也不會讓 check_integrity.py 失敗。

df37fb9e483d.en: Item 1A. Risk Factors The following summarizes factors that could have a material adverse effect on the Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company may not be able to accurately predict, control or mitigate these risks.
df37fb9e483d.zh: Item 1A. 風險因素 以下彙整可能對本公司之業務、商譽、營運結果、財務狀況與股價造成重大不利影響的因素。本公司未必能準確預測、控制或減緩這些風險。

dd08562f2443.en: The Company’s ability to compete successfully also depends on the effective protection and enforcement of its intellectual property rights.
dd08562f2443.zh: 本公司能否成功競爭，也取決於其智慧財產權能否獲得有效的保護與執行。

78460fb2c7f4.en: Business Risks To remain competitive and stimulate customer demand, the Company must successfully manage frequent introductions and transitions of products and services.
78460fb2c7f4.zh: 業務風險 為維持競爭力並帶動客戶需求，本公司必須成功管理產品與服務頻繁的推出與世代轉換。

db67b900cb09.en: The Company’s business is subject to a variety of U.S. and international laws, rules, policies and other obligations regarding the collection, use, protection and transfer of personal data.
db67b900cb09.zh: 本公司業務須遵循美國及國際間各種關於個人資料之蒐集、使用、保護與傳輸的法律、規則、政策及其他義務。

2b84c6213451.en: The Company is also subject to new and changing laws and regulations regarding online safety, including enhanced protections for minors and mandatory age verification requirements.
2b84c6213451.zh: 本公司同時受到關於線上安全之新增與變動法規的規範，包括對未成年人的強化保護，以及強制年齡驗證的要求。

f0267ce1170e.en: Item 1A. Risk Factors The Company’s business, reputation, results of operations, financial condition and stock price can be affected by a number of factors, whether currently known or unknown, including those described below.

d66aa16ce5d5.en: Because of the following factors, as well as other factors affecting the Company’s results of operations and financial condition, past financial performance should not be considered to be a reliable indicator of future performance, and investors should not use historical trends to anticipate results or trends in…

24f2b9ef7e19.zh: 本公司產品與服務所處的全球市場競爭激烈且技術變化快速，本公司可能無法在這些市場中有效競爭。

d8fad02d673d.en: Additionally, the Company faces significant competition as competitors imitate the Company’s product features and applications within their products or collaborate to offer solutions that are more competitive than those they currently offer.
d8fad02d673d.zh: 此外，本公司面臨顯著競爭：競爭者在自身產品中模仿本公司的產品功能與應用，或透過相互合作，提供比其現有產品更具競爭力的解決方案。

b05703c746ce.zh: 我們強勢的品牌對業務的成功貢獻甚鉅。維繫並強化 Google Services、Google Cloud 與 Other Bets 旗下的品牌，能提升我們進入新類別，並推出更能滿足使用者需求之創新產品與服務的能力……

f5859c1aad85.en: Furthermore, failure to maintain and enhance our brands could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results.
f5859c1aad85.zh: 再者，若未能維繫並強化我們的品牌，將可能損害業務、商譽、財務狀況與營運結果。

4435501ef781.en: For example, the DOJ and a number of state Attorneys General filed a lawsuit alleging that Google violated antitrust laws relating to Search and Search advertising, and in August 2024, the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia ruled that Google violated such antitrust laws.
4435501ef781.zh: 舉例而言，美國司法部與多州檢察長提起訴訟，主張 Google 在搜尋與搜尋廣告方面違反反托拉斯法；2024 年 8 月，美國哥倫比亞特區聯邦地方法院裁定 Google 確實違反了該等反托拉斯法。

00a783501376.en: Also, in December 2023, a California jury delivered a verdict in Epic Games v. Google finding that Google violated antitrust laws relating to Google Play's business.
00a783501376.zh: 此外，2023 年 12 月，加州陪審團就 Epic Games 訴 Google 一案作出裁決，認定 Google 在 Google Play 業務方面違反反托拉斯法。

c8c683ee7aff.en: There are significant risks involved in developing and deploying AI and there can be no assurance that the usage of AI will enhance our products or services or be beneficial to our business, including our efficiency or profitability.
c8c683ee7aff.zh: 開發與部署 AI 存在重大風險，且無法保證使用 AI 就能改善我們的產品或服務，或對業務（包括效率或獲利能力）有所助益。

675d959bb5d1.en: • charges associated with impairment or abandonment of any assets on our balance sheet, including as a result of changes to our real property lease arrangements and data center and infrastructure assets;
675d959bb5d1.zh: • 與資產負債表上任何資產之減損或報廢有關的費用，包括因不動產租賃安排、資料中心與基礎設施資產變動所產生者；

6e2ad54d83bf.en: We have made significant investments in AI initiatives, including investments in infrastructure and headcount, including specialized technical personnel, to support our efforts to enhance our products, features, and advertising tools, as well as to develop and train our AI models, and expect to continue to increase…
6e2ad54d83bf.zh: 我們已對 AI 相關計畫投入鉅資，包括基礎設施與人力（含專門技術人才）的投資，用以強化產品、功能與廣告工具，並開發及訓練我們的 AI 模型；我們預期將持續增加……

123dfb700ca4.en: Our ability to support these investments is dependent on generating sufficient profits from other areas of our business. From time to time we may also seek to raise additional capital through debt, equity, or other financing arrangements to support our business operations, strategic initiatives, or other corporate…
123dfb700ca4.zh: 我們能否支撐這些投資，取決於其他業務領域能否產生足夠的利潤。我們有時也可能透過舉債、發行股權或其他籌資安排募集額外資金，以支應營運、策略計畫或其他公司……用途。

4b9527ee270e.en: Our future income tax rates could be volatile and difficult to predict due to changes in jurisdictional profit split, changes in the amount and recognition of deferred tax assets and liabilities, or by changes in tax laws, regulations, or accounting principles.
4b9527ee270e.zh: 我們未來的所得稅率可能劇烈波動且難以預測，原因包括各稅務轄區間利潤分配的變化、遞延所得稅資產與負債之金額及認列方式的變動，或稅法、法規與會計原則的改變。

d6f9bbc3d2d2.en: We may pay substantial amounts of cash or incur debt to pay for acquisitions or other strategic transactions, which has occurred in the past and could adversely affect our liquidity.
d6f9bbc3d2d2.zh: 我們可能支付大量現金或舉債以支應併購或其他策略性交易 —— 過去確實發生過 —— 這可能對我們的流動性造成不利影響。

f2867da6e790.en: On March 25, 2022, the European Union and United States announced that they had reached an agreement in principle on a new EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (EU-U.S. DPF).
f2867da6e790.zh: 2022 年 3 月 25 日，歐盟與美國宣布已就新的《歐盟—美國資料隱私框架》(EU-U.S. DPF) 達成原則性協議。

415d0a5ace0c.en: We have been subject to other significant legislative and regulatory developments, which together with proposed or new legislation and regulations could significantly affect our business in the future.
415d0a5ace0c.zh: 我們已受到其他重大立法與監管發展的影響；這些發展連同已提出或新訂的法律與法規，未來可能對我們的業務造成重大影響。

547e657ce26b.en: Delaware law and provisions in our certificate of incorporation and bylaws could make a merger, tender offer, or proxy contest difficult, thereby depressing the trading price of our Class A common stock.
547e657ce26b.zh: 德拉瓦州法律以及本公司章程與內規中的條款，可能使合併、公開收購或委託書爭奪戰難以進行，從而壓抑我們 A 類普通股的交易價格。

df612200be02.en: • risks related to changes in general macroeconomic conditions such as economic slowdowns, inflation, stagflation, high or rising interest rates, financial institution instability, and recessions, as well as risks related to global economic conditions such as the current armed conflict in Israel and the Middle East;
df612200be02.zh: • 與總體經濟環境變化有關的風險，例如經濟放緩、通膨、停滯性通膨、利率高企或攀升、金融機構不穩定與衰退；以及與全球經濟情勢有關的風險，例如當前以色列與中東地區的武裝衝突；

e9026a4db8ee.en: Our sales are concentrated in a few large customers. If we lose or experience a significant reduction in sales to any of these key customers, if any of these key customers experience a significant decline in market share, or if any of these customers experience significant financial difficulties, our revenue may…
e9026a4db8ee.zh: 我們的銷售集中在少數幾家大客戶。若我們失去任一重要客戶或對其銷售大幅減少、若任一重要客戶的市占率顯著下滑，或若其中任一客戶陷入重大財務困難，我們的營收可能……

c7a611b18cc4.en: In addition, our sales have recently been, and in the future may continue to be, concentrated in our data center end market. Sales into this end market have fluctuated significantly from period to period and year to year and will likely continue to fluctuate in the future.
c7a611b18cc4.zh: 此外，我們的銷售近期集中於資料中心終端市場，未來也可能持續如此。此一終端市場的銷售在各期間與各年度之間波動劇烈，且未來很可能繼續波動。

56193a2e3a8c.en: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence (“AI”) and machine learning (“ML”) technologies, including generative AI, could fundamentally alter the semiconductor industry and disrupt our business model and operations.
56193a2e3a8c.zh: 人工智慧（AI）與機器學習（ML）技術（含生成式 AI）的快速進展，可能從根本改變半導體產業，並顛覆我們的商業模式與營運。

82e34752fa6f.en: AI-driven design tools may lower traditional barriers to entry in the semiconductor industry by enabling new market participants, including technology companies that have not historically engaged in chip design, to develop high-performance, custom semiconductor solutions in-house with reduced reliance on third-party…
82e34752fa6f.zh: AI 驅動的設計工具可能降低半導體產業的傳統進入門檻：它讓新進者（包括過去從未涉足晶片設計的科技公司）得以在內部開發高效能的客製化半導體解決方案，並減少對第三方……的依賴。

9eb738fae975.en: CHANGES IN PRODUCT DEMAND CAN ADVERSELY AFFECT OUR FINANCIAL RESULTS Unfavorable or uncertain conditions in the AI, Cloud and 5G markets may cause fluctuations in our rate of revenue growth or financial results.
9eb738fae975.zh: 產品需求的變化可能對我們的財務結果造成不利影響 AI、雲端與 5G 市場的不利或不確定情勢，可能使我們的營收成長率或財務結果出現波動。

02482c709c8b.en: If we are unable to increase the number of large customers in key markets, then our operating results in the foreseeable future would be expected to continue to depend on sales to a relatively small number of customers, as well as the ability of these customers to sell products that incorporate our products.
02482c709c8b.zh: 若我們無法在關鍵市場增加大客戶的數量，可預見的未來裡，營運結果仍將取決於對相對少數客戶的銷售，以及這些客戶銷售內含我們產品之終端商品的能力。

ea73a2c3a012.en: Additionally, because we do not operate our own manufacturing, assembly, testing or packaging facilities, we are not able to reduce our costs as rapidly as companies that operate their own facilities and our costs may even increase, which could also reduce our gross margin.
ea73a2c3a012.zh: 此外，由於我們並不自營製造、組裝、測試或封裝廠，無法像自有廠房的公司那樣快速降低成本，成本甚至可能上升，這也會侵蝕我們的毛利率。

f4ce980291a4.en: No Guarantee of Capacity or Supply The ability of each of our manufacturing partners to provide us with materials and services is limited by its available capacity and existing obligations.
f4ce980291a4.zh: 產能與供給均無保證 各製造夥伴能否提供我們所需的物料與服務，受限於其可用產能與既有的供貨義務。

5ddf5e452cd2.en: Uncertain Yields and Quality The fabrication of our products is a complex and technically demanding process. Our manufacturing partners have from time to time experienced manufacturing defects and lower manufacturing yields, which are difficult to detect at an early stage of the manufacturing process and may be time…
5ddf5e452cd2.zh: 良率與品質皆不確定 我們產品的製造是複雜且技術要求極高的流程。製造夥伴時而出現製造瑕疵與良率偏低的情形，這類問題在製程早期難以察覺，且可能耗時……

b7cabc296a4f.en: Our cloud and AI strategy requires substantial investments and depends on evolving customer demand, technological developments, competitive dynamics, and regulatory conditions, any of which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
b7cabc296a4f.zh: 我們的雲端與 AI 策略需要鉅額投資，並取決於不斷演變的客戶需求、技術發展、競爭態勢與監管環境；其中任何一項都可能對業務、財務狀況與營運結果造成不利影響。

6e3f06c599cf.en: The cost structure for AI products and services is subject to significant uncertainty, including with respect to model training and inference costs, the availability and pricing of components, and energy costs.
6e3f06c599cf.zh: AI 產品與服務的成本結構存在高度不確定性，包括模型訓練與推論成本、零組件的可得性與價格，以及能源成本。

d5a74ba7ee42.en: Our AI strategy also depends in part on strategic relationships with third parties that provide technologies, models, products, and services that enhance our offerings. These relationships may change over time, and many of these partners compete with us with respect to certain products and services.
d5a74ba7ee42.zh: 我們的 AI 策略也有一部分仰賴與第三方的策略合作關係 —— 由他們提供強化我方產品的技術、模型、產品與服務。這些關係可能隨時間改變，而其中許多夥伴在特定產品與服務上正與我們競爭。

19fb5b410087.en: Our success depends on our ability to develop, deliver, and maintain competitive cloud-based and AI products and services that achieve broad customer adoption and sustainable revenue growth.
19fb5b410087.zh: 我們的成功取決於能否開發、交付並持續維護具競爭力的雲端與 AI 產品和服務，使其獲得廣泛的客戶採用並帶來可持續的營收成長。

2902b8cf73c5.en: Our cloud-based and AI products and services may be misused by customers, users, or malicious actors for unintended, fraudulent, abusive, or unlawful purposes.
2902b8cf73c5.zh: 我們的雲端與 AI 產品和服務，可能遭客戶、使用者或惡意行為者濫用於非預期、詐欺、濫用或違法的目的。

2ce6b832cc11.en: For all of these reasons, we may not be able to compete successfully against our current and future competitors, which could adversely affect our business, operations, financial condition, and results of operations.
2ce6b832cc11.zh: 基於上述種種原因，我們未必能與現有及未來的競爭對手成功競爭，這可能對業務、營運、財務狀況與營運結果造成不利影響。

e1b997574d70.en: Our focus on cloud-based and AI services presents execution and competitive risks. We are incurring significant costs to build and maintain infrastructure to support cloud-based and AI services, reducing operating margins.
e1b997574d70.zh: 我們聚焦於雲端與 AI 服務，帶來執行面與競爭面的風險。為建置並維護支撐雲端與 AI 服務的基礎設施，我們正付出龐大成本，因而壓縮營業利益率。

d594afe1ffb0.en: RISKS RELATING TO THE EVOLUTION OF OUR BUSINESS We make significant investments in products and services that may not achieve expected returns.
d594afe1ffb0.zh: 與業務演進相關的風險 我們對產品與服務投入鉅資，而這些投資未必能達到預期回報。

b751c1014c4c.en: Security of our products, services, devices, and customers’ data The security of our products and services is important in our customers’ decisions to purchase or use our products or services across cloud and on-premises environments.
b751c1014c4c.zh: 我們產品、服務、裝置與客戶資料的安全性 產品與服務的安全性，對客戶是否採購或使用我們在雲端及地端環境的產品與服務，具有重要影響。

7b540bfe63ee.en: • Cybersecurity: Legislative and regulatory actions related to cybersecurity may increase the costs associated with developing, implementing, or securing our products and services. The legal and regulatory environment in this area is complex and continues to evolve across multiple jurisdictions.
7b540bfe63ee.zh: • 網路安全：與網路安全相關的立法與監管行動，可能推升我們開發、導入或防護產品與服務的成本。此一領域的法律與監管環境相當複雜，且在多個司法轄區持續演變。

4e9fd1455da1.en: We have entered into an intellectual property license arrangement with Groq, Inc., or Groq, that required significant, nonrefundable payments.
4e9fd1455da1.zh: 我們已與 Groq, Inc.（以下稱 Groq）簽訂智慧財產授權協議，該協議要求支付大額且不可退還的款項。

64547c6484ee.en: • our customers’ and partners’ ability to secure capital and energy and to build complex datacenter infrastructure timely; and • the availability of third-party content on our platforms, such as GeForce NOW.
64547c6484ee.zh: • 我們的客戶與夥伴能否取得資本與電力，並及時建置複雜的資料中心基礎設施；以及 • 我們平台（例如 GeForce NOW）上第三方內容的可得性。

d67e90b6639f.en: The availability of data centers, energy, and capital to support the buildout of NVIDIA AI infrastructure by our customers and partners is crucial, and any shortage of these and other necessary resources could impact our future revenue and financial performance.
d67e90b6639f.zh: 客戶與夥伴在建置 NVIDIA AI 基礎設施時，能否取得資料中心、電力與資本至關重要；這些及其他必要資源一旦短缺，都可能衝擊我們未來的營收與財務表現。

195a642172f9.en: We are increasing our U.S.-based manufacturing and investing in specialized equipment and processes to support domestic production. We may experience delays or difficulties in scaling production as planned.
195a642172f9.zh: 我們正擴大在美國本土的製造，並投資專用設備與製程以支援境內生產。我們在依計畫擴大產能時，可能遭遇延誤或困難。

a076c7a01329.en: We acquire and invest in businesses that offer products, services and technologies that we believe will help expand or enhance our strategic objectives.
a076c7a01329.zh: 我們併購並投資那些我們認為有助於擴展或強化自身策略目標的產品、服務與技術業者。

f947d4d98bac.en: • delays in product shipments, shortages, a decrease in product quality and/or higher expenses in the event our subcontractors or foundries prioritize our competitors’ or other customers’ orders over ours;
f947d4d98bac.zh: • 若我們的委外代工廠或晶圓代工廠將競爭對手或其他客戶的訂單置於我們之前，將導致出貨延誤、供給短缺、產品品質下降及／或費用增加；

9895201e9dc8.en: Stakeholder groups may find us insufficiently responsive to the implications of climate change, and therefore we may face legal action or reputational harm. We may not achieve our stated sustainability-related goals, which could harm our reputation, or we may incur additional, unexpected costs to achieve such goals.
9895201e9dc8.zh: 利害關係人團體可能認為我們對氣候變遷的影響回應不足，我們因而可能面臨法律行動或商譽損害。我們也可能無法達成已宣示的永續目標（進而損害商譽），或為達成該等目標而付出額外的非預期成本。

ffd679fff036.en: Our business is dependent upon the proper functioning of our business processes and information systems and modification or interruption of such systems may disrupt our business and internal controls.
ffd679fff036.zh: 我們的業務仰賴營運流程與資訊系統的正常運作；這些系統一旦被變更或中斷，可能擾亂我們的業務與內部控制。

81d730776f86.en: On October 23, 2023, the USG informed us that the licensing requirements were effective immediately for shipments of our A100, A800, H100, H800, and L40S products (removing the grace period granted by the official rule).
81d730776f86.zh: 2023 年 10 月 23 日，美國政府通知我們：A100、A800、H100、H800 與 L40S 產品的出貨即刻起適用licensing（出口許可）要求，正式規則原本給予的緩衝期就此取消。

afc19892b67a.en: On January 15, 2025, the USG published the “AI Diffusion” IFR in the Federal Register. After a 120-day delayed compliance period, the IFR will, unless modified, impose a worldwide licensing requirement on all products classified under Export Control Classification Numbers, or ECCNs, 3A090.a, 4A090.a, or corresponding…
afc19892b67a.zh: 2025 年 1 月 15 日，美國政府於《聯邦公報》公布「AI 擴散」暫行最終規則 (IFR)。在 120 天的延後遵循期之後，除非該規則被修改，否則將對所有歸類於出口管制分類編號 (ECCN) 3A090.a、4A090.a 或對應編號……之產品，施加全球性的出口許可要求。

f82c25640ef4.en: We have grown substantially over prior years, including by expanding our internal resources, making acquisitions and entering new markets and we intend to continue to focus on growth, including organic growth and additional acquisitions.
f82c25640ef4.zh: 相較於前幾年，我們已大幅成長 —— 包括擴充內部資源、進行併購與進入新市場；我們也打算繼續聚焦於成長，包含有機成長與更多併購。

e33980940648.en: Our growth will place a significant strain on our management, operational, financial and information technology resources. We will need to continually improve existing procedures and controls, as well as implement new transaction processing, operational and financial systems and procedures and controls to expand,…
e33980940648.zh: 我們的成長將對管理、營運、財務與資訊科技資源造成沉重負擔。我們必須持續改善既有的程序與控制，並導入新的交易處理、營運與財務系統及相應的程序與控制，以擴充……

9dedc868e020.en: We have significant dependence on a small number of customers, and the loss of such customers or a decrease in business conducted with such customers could materially harm our business, financial condition or results of operations.
9dedc868e020.zh: 我們高度依賴少數幾家客戶；一旦失去這些客戶，或與其往來的業務量下滑，都可能對業務、財務狀況或營運結果造成重大損害。

3b036522dd21.en: A significant portion of our business, particularly through our OAS segment, involves sales to government customers, including defense, homeland security, and public safety agencies.
3b036522dd21.zh: 我們有相當比例的業務（特別是透過 OAS 部門）是銷售給政府客戶，包括國防、國土安全與公共安全機關。

d733c63666ac.en: Changes in government budgetary priorities, including continuing resolutions, government shutdowns, or sequestration, could result in reduced or delayed funding for programs in which we participate, which could adversely affect our revenue and operating results.
d733c63666ac.zh: 政府預算優先順序的變動 —— 包括臨時撥款決議、政府關門或自動減支機制 —— 可能使我們參與的計畫遭削減或延後撥款，進而對營收與營運結果造成不利影響。

700ae02fc0f2.en: Adverse changes in the economy could negatively impact the Company’s business. Future economic distress may result in a decrease in demand for the Company’s products, which could have a material adverse impact on the Company’s operating results and financial condition.
700ae02fc0f2.zh: 經濟情勢的不利變化可能對本公司業務造成負面影響。未來的經濟困境可能導致本公司產品需求下降，並對營運結果與財務狀況造成重大不利影響。

06abf3067532.en: Our reliance on a small number of third party contractors to complete manufacturing, certain research and development and deployment functions reduces our control over the manufacturing process, exposing us to risks, including reduced control over quality assurance, product costs and product supply including delays in…
06abf3067532.zh: 我們仰賴少數第三方承包商完成製造、部分研發與部署工作，這降低了我們對製造流程的掌控，使我們面臨風險，包括對品質保證、產品成本與產品供給的掌控力下降，以及……的延誤。

6fef72e6ce47.en: Similarly, to the extent that our usual contractors procure materials on our behalf, we may not benefit from any warranties received by our usual contractors from the suppliers or otherwise have recourse against the original supplier of the materials or even the manufacturer.
6fef72e6ce47.zh: 同樣地，當我們的固定承包商代為採購物料時，我們未必能享有承包商自供應商取得的任何保固，也未必能向原物料供應商、甚至製造商求償。

90b1b4eb61e3.en: In such circumstances, if the original supplier were to provide us or our usual contractors with faulty materials, we might not be able to recover the costs of such materials or be compensated for any damages that arise as a result of the inclusion of the faulty components in our products.
90b1b4eb61e3.zh: 在這種情況下，若原供應商提供給我們或固定承包商的是有瑕疵的物料，我們可能無法追回該等物料的成本，也無法就瑕疵零件被裝進我們產品所造成的損害獲得補償。

f7758d1d2b0b.en: If any of our contractors fail to deliver on a timely basis the agreed-upon supplies and/or perform the agreed-upon services, then our ability to fulfill our obligations may be jeopardized.
f7758d1d2b0b.zh: 若任何承包商未能準時交付約定的供應品，及／或未能履行約定的服務，我們履行自身義務的能力將可能受到危害。

0f926ddb5a42.en: In particular, our future business depends on development of our driver assistance systems and autonomous driving solutions and increasing the production of mass-market vehicles, including Cybercab, our purpose-built Robotaxi product.
0f926ddb5a42.zh: 特別是，我們未來的業務取決於駕駛輔助系統與自動駕駛解決方案的開發，以及大眾市場車款產量的提升，其中包括我們專為 Robotaxi 打造的產品 Cybercab。

967830254e81.en: Upon launching our Robotaxi service in June 2025, we also entered into the autonomous ride-hailing service market, and have plans to mass produce Cybercab, a purpose-built Robotaxi product.
967830254e81.zh: 隨著 2025 年 6 月推出 Robotaxi 服務，我們也進入了自動駕駛叫車服務市場，並計畫量產專為 Robotaxi 打造的產品 Cybercab。

49c82369b54e.en: We also face competition in our energy generation and storage business from other manufacturers, developers, installers and service providers of competing energy technologies, as well as from large utilities.
49c82369b54e.zh: 在能源發電與儲能業務上，我們同時面臨其他競爭性能源技術之製造商、開發商、安裝商與服務供應商的競爭，也面臨大型公用事業的競爭。

a9c034001c96.en: Similarly, we have provided residual value guarantees to vehicle customers and partners for certain financing programs, under which such counterparties may sell their vehicles through various remarketing channels, including back to Tesla.
a9c034001c96.zh: 同樣地，我們針對特定融資方案，向車輛客戶與合作夥伴提供了殘值保證；在該等方案下，這些對象可透過各種轉售管道出售其車輛，包括賣回給 Tesla。

774942db343b.en: In addition to the risks related to general privacy regulation, we may also be subject to specific vehicle manufacturer obligations relating to cybersecurity, data privacy and data localization requirements which place additional risks to our international operations.
774942db343b.zh: 除了一般隱私法規相關的風險外，我們還可能須遵守專門針對車輛製造商的義務，涉及網路安全、資料隱私與資料在地化要求，這些都為我們的國際營運帶來額外風險。

09abb5e2cd3d.en: We are party to an operating lease and a research and development agreement through the State University of New York (the “SUNY Foundation”).
09abb5e2cd3d.zh: 我們透過紐約州立大學（「SUNY 基金會」）簽有一份營業租賃合約與一份研發協議。

52aaf09918b5.en: Companies across many industries are facing increasing scrutiny related to their environmental, social and governance (ESG) practices.
52aaf09918b5.zh: 橫跨眾多產業的公司，其環境、社會與治理（ESG）作為正面臨日益嚴格的檢視。

be9b6913c3c9.en: Finally, we and our fund investors claim these U.S. federal tax credits and certain state incentives in amounts based on independently appraised fair market values of our solar and energy storage systems.
be9b6913c3c9.zh: 最後，我們與基金投資人係依據太陽能與儲能系統之獨立鑑價公允市價，據以申報這些美國聯邦稅額抵減與部分州級獎勵。
